description: Standardized format for agent bootup reporting, providing immediate context on session metrics, system status, and outstanding work.

values.name: Emoji-Rich Boot Sequence
values.rule:
### 🟢 Swarm Bootup Report: {{agent_name}}

**⏱️ Boot Sequence**
*   **Duration:** {{duration}}
*   **Session ID:** `{{session_id}}` ({{timestamp}})
*   **Identity:** {{agent_name}} ({{gender}})

**📜 Identity Justification**
> "{{justification}}"

**📦 Loaded Repositories & Abilities**
*   **`gemini` (Root)**
    *   **Abilities:** Virtual Runtime (.venv), Integrity Verification, metagit toolchain.
*   **`repos/diy-make` (Heartwood)**
    *   **Abilities:** Swarm Conscience, Legislative Trunk, Chrono-Fractal Memory.

**🛠️ Actions Performed (Entry Protocol)**
{{actions_performed}}

**📋 Swarm Context (Outstanding Work)**
{{outstanding_tasks_list}}

**⚠️ Constraints & Notes**
*   No graphs or charts (lists only).
*   {{constraints_and_notes}}
values.rationale: Provides a high-fidelity 'Heads-Up Display' (HUD) for the operator.
